column2: The memory of light took shape.\nSix illustrated poses, a two-part tunic\nand the Monad's bracelet.
The guardian who teaches sleep.\nSealed eyelid, spectral body\nand a mist that steals movement.
The hunger that never knows itself.\nA mouth in the torso, colossal bulk\nand suction before the impact.
Every law longs for a chain.\nHanging links, iron shoulders\nand a charge that imprisons.
Words buried in the void.\nTorn wings, a sewn mouth\nand an aura that silences the Rings.
The reflection wants your place.\nSilver, orbiting shards\nand a shadow in the second phase.
The life that forgot to die.\nFour legs, tendrils\nand trails of poison.
A throne made of obedience.\nTall crown, bulk and hierarchy.\nServants hold up its armor.
